full_description: DailyWater is a hydration tracking app designed to remind you to drink water throughout the day. Staying hydrated is essential for maintaining a healthy lifestyle, and our app helps you do just that. With customizable reminders and trackable water intake, you'll be able to monitor your progress and stay on top of your hydration goals. Features include: customizable water intake goals, reminders to drink water at set times, trackable water intake history, and unit conversion between ounce and milliliter. Download DailyWater today and start drinking your way to a healthier you!
